calls.reason: DeepMind's own Nature paper says AlphaProof's successes are primarily in competition math, while reporting a large jump over prior AI (84% vs 54% geometry; first IMO medal-level result).
The AG1 Nature paper calls itself neuro-symbolic, AG2 pairs a Gemini language model with a symbolic engine, and AlphaProof is a learned agent proving in Lean; all three reported strong results.
The AG2 paper reports 30 of 39 formalizable problems auto-formalized, but the benchmark splits 45 originals into 50 entries and gives no item-level results, so the 60% ceiling can't be confirmed.
The packet only confirms the TechCrunch headline wording; it provides no matched evidence on what DeepMind claimed or whether the headline's broader claim was false.
The February 2025 AG2 paper reports 84% on 50 IMO geometry entries while documenting uncovered classes such as inequalities, variable numbers of points, 3D geometry and nonlinear equations.
This is an open-ended conditional; the packet found no implemented combination of general AIs with AG2 and no comparison against talented high-school students.
